Banks in Ghana will begin collecting a 20 per cent tax on foreign digital subscriptions starting 15 October.

The charge applies to debit card payments for services like Netflix, Zoom, Spotify, and ChatGPT.

The tax combines VAT, GETFund, and NHIL levies collected directly at checkout.
